title: Insulation Calculator
metaDescription: Find the ENERGY STAR attic R-value for your US climate zone and estimate AttiCat blown bags or EcoTouch batt packages, plus the thickness to install.
secondaryKeywords: what r value insulation for attic
how many bags of blown insulation do i need
intent: Find the recommended attic R-value for a US climate zone and estimate the batts or blown-in bags needed to reach it.
registerRow: Keyword Register (estimates): insulation calculator - volume 3, competition ease 2, ad value 4, fit 4, priority 24
intro: Find the R-value ENERGY STAR recommends adding to your attic for your US climate zone, then estimate Owens Corning AttiCat blown-in bags or EcoTouch batt packages for that attic floor. Blown results include the data sheet's minimum thickness.
chartTitle: AttiCat bags to buy at each chart R-value
heroAlt: Cross-section of an attic: roof rafters, floor joists, and a layer of insulation above the joists with a depth mark.
uniqueAddition: An on-page ENERGY STAR attic R-value table for every climate-zone group, paired with the AttiCat bag line for this attic at R-30, R-38, R-49, and R-60. Blown results name the AttiCat data-sheet row used and its minimum thickness so the depth can be checked in the attic.

inputs.name: area
inputs.label: Attic floor area
inputs.help: 100 to 5,000 sq ft. Measure the flat attic floor, not the sloped roof.

inputs.name: climateZone
inputs.label: US climate zone
inputs.help: IECC zone from the Department of Energy map linked in How to use. Zones 4 through 8 share attic targets in pairs on the ENERGY STAR table. This page does not look up your county.

inputs.name: existing
inputs.label: Existing insulation
inputs.help: ENERGY STAR prints two attic columns: none, or about 3-4 inches already there. Both give the R-value to add on top. Other depths are not converted into an R-value here.

inputs.name: product
inputs.label: Product type
inputs.help: Blown fiberglass uses the AttiCat 27.5 lb bag chart. Batts use EcoTouch thickness and the package coverage you enter.

inputs.name: battR
inputs.label: Batt R-value
inputs.help: Used for batts. Thickness is the standard EcoTouch batt: R-13 is 3.5 in, R-19 is 6.25 in, R-30 is 9.5 in, R-38 is 12 in. One layer only. Compressed cathedral batts are not included.

inputs.name: battCoverage
inputs.label: Batt package coverage
inputs.help: Used for batts. Square feet printed on the package. The 64 starting value is one EcoTouch fact-sheet row: R-38, 12 in thick, 24 in wide, 48 in long, 8 pieces, 64.0 sq ft. Other widths cover a different amount, and that fact sheet is from 2012, so match your label. Allowed range is 10 to 400.

inputs.name: targetR
inputs.label: Target R-value override
inputs.help: Optional, 13 to 60. Leave blank to use the ENERGY STAR R-value to add. For blown fiberglass, a target between AttiCat data-sheet rows uses the next higher row (for example R-25 uses R-26).

inputs.name: extraWaste
inputs.label: Extra waste
inputs.help: 0 to 15. The AttiCat chart and the package coverage already describe full coverage. Add a percent only if you want an extra pad. Purchase counts still round up.
